summary: Backend-only testing of MakeMyEventPro Phase 1. Wrote pytest suite covering OTP auth (mocked), RBAC (customer/vendor/super_admin), public marketplace endpoints, customer flows (favorites/enquiries/events/checklist), vendor dashboard, and admin console. 32 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed.

minor.issue: Slug 'vendor-hub-787' does not exist in seed data (that string is actually the preview subdomain, not a vendor slug). Endpoint correctly returns 404 for unknown slugs. Requirement wording appears to be a copy/paste error — real seeded slugs include e.g. 'falaknuma-grand-convention'. Test was skipped for that particular slug.

action_items: Confirm intended vendor slug for detail-endpoint smoke test (likely 'falaknuma-grand-convention' not 'vendor-hub-787'). Update spec accordingly.
Consider persisting rate-limit protection on verify-otp too (currently only send-otp is rate-limited).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~525 lines, borderline; still acceptable but consider splitting into routers (auth/marketplace/customer/vendor/admin) before Phase 2.
verify-otp bypass via universal '123456' is fine for demo but must be gated by an ENV flag before Firebase integration to prevent it leaking to production.
send-otp rate limit uses ISO-string comparison on created_at; works because ISO 8601 is lexicographically ordered but a real Date field with TTL index would be more robust.
make_token embeds role in JWT but get_current_user re-fetches user each call — good (role changes take effect immediately). Confirm this is intentional.
Admin action mapping resets 'verified' to False on 'reject' but 'suspend' leaves verified untouched — verify desired behaviour.
customer_events checklist 'spent' recomputes only completed items; make sure the client sends full checklist on each PUT (documented behaviour).
No pagination cap on limit query param in /api/vendors — clamp to sane max (e.g., 100) to prevent abuse.
test_credentials: Admin phone 9999900001 / Vendor phone 9999900002 / any 10-digit phone = customer / universal OTP 123456 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md)
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral customer users via random 10-digit phones and TEST_-prefixed enquiries/events. No cleanup performed (mocked auth, safe for demo DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Note the 'vendor-hub-787' slug mismatch in the review spec; use real seeded slugs from GET /api/vendors.
